platform: macOS aarch64 Release gate with OpenJDK javap 21.0.8
trigger: all six fixed real-project validations scanned ordinary nested classes whose verbose javap output contains a post-body NestHost: class attribute
actual_pre_fix_behavior: the independent direct-edge and structural parsers treated NestHost: class <outer> as a second top-level class declaration and failed validation with javap/classfile owner mismatch
expected_behavior: only a Java declaration line with legal declaration modifiers may establish the rendered owner; class-level NestHost and other colon-delimited attributes must not replace the raw classfile this_class owner
root_cause: CLASS_DECLARATION_RE accepted any non-whitespace prefix before the class keyword, so the attribute label NestHost: satisfied the declaration grammar
reproduction: Run javap -verbose -c -s -p on the fixed nested-class entry and compare its first declaration with the raw classfile this_class value.
Feed the complete output, including the post-body NestHost attribute, through both independent Oracle parsers.
